headline: Revenue climbs but bottom line cools amid a debt reshuffle
summary_short: MKS Instruments reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $1,078M, up 4.4% q/q and 15.2% y/y, but diluted EPS fell 25.3% q/q to $1.18 (still +53.2% y/y) as short-term debt jumped to $1,398M from $51M q/q.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,078M, +4.4% q/q and +15.2% y/y. Gross margin was ~47.0%, roughly flat q/q and down slightly y/y from 47.4%. EBITDA was $232M (+1.3% q/q, +14.3% y/y); operating income $149M (-4.5% q/q, +34.2% y/y). Net income fell to $84M (-21.5% q/q, +61.5% y/y); diluted EPS was $1.18 (-25.3% q/q, +53.2% y/y). Cash rose to $463M (+10.8% q/q, +13.8% y/y); long-term debt fell to $2,650M from $4,150M q/q while short-term debt rose to $1,398M from $51M.
